configurations.name: static-preview
runtimeArgs: import os,http.server; port=int(os.environ.get('PORT',8843)); http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer.allow_reuse_address=True; Handler=http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler; httpd=http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer(('',port),Handler); print('Serving HTTP on port', port); httpd.serve_forever()
